title: 第十一章 林师兄第十二章 死刑犯的功法
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
十几分钟后，林枫便堆了一个黄土堆。
心里默念一声，感谢道友馈赠。
一旁的郑宏文望着林枫，忍不住问道：“林师弟，怎么感觉你的速度和力量比之前更厉害了。
这忙乎半天也不见你脸红气喘？”
林枫轻咳一声，“郑师兄可能看错了吧”
随即转移话题，“郑师兄，今天吃肉的日子，还不早点回去”
说完林枫估计装出一副很累的样子。
闻言，郑宏文一拍额头。
急忙道：“对对对，吃肉的日子，快回去，这吃一次肉可不容易”
说着就急忙解开牛绳，拉着牛就往城里走。
回城的路上，林枫坐在牛车上，找了个话题道：
“郑师兄，咱们师傅是什么境界？”
“师傅啊？据说是炼体四层圆满，就再也没有寸进”
“这是为什么？”
“好像是因为砍头太多煞气太重，导致心脉受损。
我也是听闻，至于具体的原因我就不得而知”
“师傅是不是有个女儿？”林枫忽然想到了之前见到姜虎身后的女人。
“你说姜柔师姐啊，她是师傅收养的一个孤儿，不是亲生的。
师傅以前是刽子手，女人听到后都害怕，没人敢嫁给师傅。
因此，师傅自然也没有孩子”

林枫恍然，原来如此。
目光望着郑宏文的背影，也不再追问。
十几分钟后，便到了城门口。
城门外的守卫，看到郑宏文和林枫的马甲立马放行。
到了善堂，郑宏文迫不及待道：“林师弟可饿死我了，一会儿要多吃几碗”
说完便将牛绳扔给林枫，跑去洗漱一番。
等林枫系好牛绳，就见郑宏文拿着筷子碗一脸兴奋的跑到厨房。
当揭开锅盖，看到锅里面的情况，郑宏文脸色顿时拉了下来。
锅中只剩下一口肉汤，还有半个馒头。
其它什么都没有了。
郑宏文忍不住气的破口大骂：
“他妈的，不知道还有人没吃吗？
十日才吃一次肉，谁嘴欠啊这是？”
刚到厨房的林枫，见状，“师兄，怎么了？”
“草他姥姥的，啥都没有了，咱们累死累活的，饭都没留一口。
也不知道被那个雷劈的吃了”
content_en:
Ten minutes later, Lin Feng built a pile of loess.
I muttered silently in my heart, thanking fellow Taoist for the gift.
Zheng Hongwen looked at Lin Feng and couldn't help but ask: "Junior brother Lin, why do you feel that your speed and strength are more powerful than before.
I've been busy for a long time and I still don't see you blushing and panting? "
Lin Feng coughed lightly and said, "Senior Brother Zheng may have seen it wrong."
Then he changed the topic, "Senior Brother Zheng, today is a meat day, why don't you go back early?"
After saying that, Lin Feng probably pretended to be very tired.
Hearing this, Zheng Hongwen slapped his forehead.
He said hurriedly: "Yes, yes, it's a meat-eating day. Go back quickly. It's not easy to eat meat this time."
After saying that, he hurriedly untied the cow rope, pulled the cow and walked towards the city.
On the way back to the city, Lin Feng sat on the bullock cart and found a topic:
"Senior Brother Zheng, what is our master's level?"
"Master? It is said that after reaching the fourth level of body refining, there is no progress."
"Why is that?"
"It seems that the evil spirit of beheading was too strong, which caused damage to the heart.
I’ve also heard about it, but I don’t know the specific reason.”
"Does the master have a daughter?" Lin Feng suddenly thought of the woman behind Jiang Hu whom he saw before.
"You said Senior Sister Jiang Rou, she is an orphan adopted by the master, not her biological child.
The master used to be an executioner. Women were frightened after hearing this, and no one dared to marry the master.
Therefore, the master naturally has no children."
Lin Feng suddenly realized that this was the case.
Looking at Zheng Hongwen's back, he stopped asking questions.
Ten minutes later, we arrived at the city gate.
The guards outside the city gate immediately let them go when they saw Zheng Hongwen and Lin Feng's vests.
When they arrived at the Shantang, Zheng Hongwen couldn't wait to say: "Junior Brother Lin is starving me to death. I will eat a few more bowls soon."
After saying that, he threw the cow rope to Lin Feng and ran to wash up.
After Lin Feng tied the cow rope, he saw Zheng Hongwen running to the kitchen with a chopstick bowl and an excited look on his face.
When he opened the lid of the pot and saw the situation inside the pot, Zheng Hongwen's expression suddenly dropped.
There was only a mouthful of broth left in the pot and half a steamed bun.
Nothing else.
Zheng Hongwen couldn't help but yelled angrily:
“Damn it, I wonder if anyone hasn’t eaten yet?
I only eat meat once every ten days, who is the one who owes me this? "
Lin Feng, who had just arrived in the kitchen, saw this and said, "Senior brother, what's wrong?"
"Damn it, grandma, there's nothing left. We were so exhausted that we didn't even have a bite to eat.
I don’t know if I was eaten by that lightning strike."
